tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the story text box, empty thumbnails, skeleton loaders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between list rows and card edges. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders (3:1 or better on surface and surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and peacock-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: peacock
tokens.usage: Brand colour: selected tab, links, secondary buttons, progress, the brand header. Text in peacock reads on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-peacock
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a peacock fill.

tokens.name: peacock-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chips, the active tab's pill, info banners. Ink or peacock text on it.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: The one main action per screen (Make my film, Publish, Buy). Fill only; never text or icons on a light surface.

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a marigold fill.

tokens.name: marigold-text
tokens.usage: Marigold as text: credit counts and the AI sparkle label, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: kumkum
tokens.usage: Record button, 'New' badges, celebration moments. Small areas only.

tokens.name: on-kumkum
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a kumkum fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Ready / Published states, always with a check icon and a word, on surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed states and destructive actions, always with an icon and a word, on surface-raised.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low credits, private-upload notices, on surface-raised.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, offset 2px; 6:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

families.display: "Baloo 2", "Baloo Bhaijaan 2", "Baloo Da 2", "Baloo Thambi 2", "Baloo Tammudu 2", system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Bengali", "Noto Sans Tamil", "Noto Sans Telugu", "Noto Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Mia finds colours in the puddles after the rain.
styles.usage: The story box and any text people type.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your video will be ready in about 2 minutes.
styles.usage: Default running text. 1.6 line height leaves room for Indic vowel signs.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small Latin labels above sections. Indic and Arabic have no capitals: use caption weight 700 instead.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and small cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top of screen to title; around empty states.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large separations on onboarding screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails inside lists, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, cards, video thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners) and the main create card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the active-tab pill.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar, plus the device's bottom safe area.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Cards that float over surface (video cards, the create card).

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the tab bar.
